collection_batches_variance_ck.name: collection_batches_variance_ck
collection_batches_variance_ck.value: status not in ('RECONCILED','CLOSED') or (variance_type is not null and difference = cash_remitted - cash_collected and ((variance_type = 'BALANCED') = (difference = 0)) and (difference = 0 or variance_reason is not null))

invoices_account_period_uq.name: invoices_account_period_uq
invoices_account_period_uq.where: billing_period is not null and status <> 'VOID'

invoices_amounts_ck.name: invoices_amounts_ck
invoices_amounts_ck.value: total >= 0 and amount_paid >= 0 and balance >= 0 and total = subtotal - discount_total

invoices_balance_ck.name: invoices_balance_ck
invoices_balance_ck.value: status in ('VOID','DRAFT') or balance = total + adjustments_total - amount_paid

invoices_finalized_ck.name: invoices_finalized_ck
invoices_finalized_ck.value: status = 'DRAFT' or invoice_no is not null

payment_proofs_ck.name: payment_proofs_ck
payment_proofs_ck.value: amount > 0 and (status <> 'VERIFIED' or (payment_id is not null and reviewed_by is not null and reviewed_at is not null))

payments_amount_ck.name: payments_amount_ck
payments_amount_ck.value: amount > 0 and unapplied_amount >= 0 and unapplied_amount <= amount

service_accounts_ck.name: service_accounts_ck
service_accounts_ck.value: due_day between 1 and 28 and current_rate > 0 and monthly_discount >= 0 and monthly_discount <= current_rate
